# Global Job Search API - Remote Jobs, All-in-One, 18 Job Boards

> Global job search API and job aggregator: one run searches 18 job boards worldwide, remote jobs too, newest first, each job once.

## Summary

Global Job Search API is an Apify actor, a universal all-in-one job search, that searches 18 job boards worldwide live and in parallel in one run, and returns one row per job, newest first across all of them, each job once: title, company, places, remote or office, job type, published pay, posting date, the board it came from (platform) and the job and apply links; with full details, the description and pay as numbers. The boards: job boards that index jobs themselves (Hiring Cafe, Y Combinator's Work at a Startup, Wellfound, Welcome to the Jungle with Otta, eFinancialCareers, Naukri, foundit, Instahyre, Hirist, Cutshort) and company career sites on eight applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse 8,357 job boards, Lever 2,396, Workday 2,207, Ashby 3,814, SmartRecruiters 2,917, Workable 2,196, Cornerstone 1,110, Deel 161). A job listed on two boards is saved once. No login and no API key.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/global-job-search-api
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/global-job-search-api

## Use it from an AI assistant

- Claude (claude.ai and the desktop app): https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=Global%20Job%20Search&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.apify.com%3Ftools%3Danshumanatrey%2Fglobal-job-search-api (click Continue, sign in to Apify, Allow).
- Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http global-job-search-api "https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/global-job-search-api", then /mcp to sign in to Apify.
- Codex: codex mcp add global-job-search-api --url "https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/global-job-search-api", then codex mcp login global-job-search-api.
- Any other MCP client: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/global-job-search-api, signed in with Apify or Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>.

## Key features

- 18 boards in one run, read at the same time, so a run takes about as long as its slowest board; Time per board (secondsPerBoard, 240 s) caps it.
- The newest jobs of all boards, newest first, up to maxJobs in all, with the board of each in platform.
- Each job once: the same job link, the same company and title in the same city, or the same company and title posted at the same second.
- The same filters on every board: titles (every word of a line in the title), places (cities, states, countries, regions, Worldwide), remote or office, job type, posting period, years of experience, words to leave out, companies.
- A pasted board link searches that board only; job links of any of the 18 boards are checked by their own board: open, closed or not found.
- The OUTPUT record has one entry per board: matches, jobs saved, seconds, jobs left out as another board's, errors.

## Input keys

- Job titles to find (searchTerms): one per line; a job matches when its title has every word; a board link searches that board only.
- Job boards (platforms): hiringcafe, greenhouse, lever, workday, ashby, smartrecruiters, workable, cornerstone, deel, ycombinator, wellfound, welcometothejungle, efinancialcareers, naukri, foundit, instahyre, hirist, cutshort; empty for all 18; names work too (Hiring Cafe, YC, Otta).
- Where the job is (location): cities, states, countries or regions; Worldwide; Remote alone asks for remote jobs.
- Remote or onsite (workType): remote, hybrid or onsite.
- Posted in the last (postedWithin): 24 hours, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days (the default), any time, or your own period.
- Number of jobs (maxJobs): jobs in all, newest first across every board; 100 by default; 0 for every match.
- Full details (includeDetails): the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers, the address.
- Leave out words (excludeTerms), Job type (employmentType), Match descriptions (searchDescriptions).
- Experience (experienceYears): 3, 2-5, 5+ or fresher; only boards that state years can match then (Hiring Cafe, Y Combinator, Wellfound, Welcome to the Jungle, the India boards).
- Only these companies (companies): names or board links; a board where none is found sits the run out.
- Job links to check (jobUrls): job links of any of the 18 boards, checked instead of searching.
- Time per board (secondsPerBoard): seconds each board may search; 240 by default; 0 for no cap of its own.

## Pricing

Pay per event, platform usage included, no monthly fee:
- Job: $0.004 ($4.00 per 1,000) on FREE and BRONZE, $0.0036 on SILVER, $0.0032 on GOLD and above; also one checked link that is closed or not found.
- Job with details: $0.005 on FREE and BRONZE, $0.0045 on SILVER, $0.004 on GOLD and above.
- Board searched: $0.01 for each board a search reads, when the run starts (18 when every board is searched); checking job links charges none.
- Examples: 100 jobs from all 18 boards $0.58; 50 jobs from 5 boards $0.25; 100 jobs from all 18 boards with full details $0.68. Apify's free $5 monthly credit covers about 8 runs of 100 jobs on all 18 boards.

## Speed

Minutes, because the boards are read at the same time, the company career sites each in a process of their own. Apify, default 8 GB, 2026-11-13: data analyst in London on all 18 boards took 236 s and read every company on every board; software engineer on 5 boards took 113 s. One CPU core per 4 GB: at 4 GB an 18-board search is cut at Time per board.

## How to call it

- Apify API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/anshumanatrey~global-job-search-api/run-sync-get-dataset-items with a JSON body such as {"searchTerms": ["data analyst"], "platforms": ["hiringcafe", "greenhouse"]}.
- Python and JavaScript: apify-client, actor "anshumanatrey/global-job-search-api".
- n8n and Make: the Apify node or app, Run an Actor and get its dataset.
- MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/global-job-search-api

## When to use

- One search for a title and a place across every major job board and company career site, newest first.
- A daily job feed or alert in one schema, for a job board, a recruiter or a job seeker.
- An AI agent that needs one job search tool instead of one per board.

## When NOT to use

- One board only: its own actor costs far less (Hiring Cafe Jobs Scraper charges $0.000062 a job).
- LinkedIn, Indeed or Glassdoor jobs: not read here.
- Applicant tracking systems beyond these eight (iCIMS, Taleo, SuccessFactors): use a database actor that lists them.

## Sample input

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["data analyst"],
  "location": ["London"],
  "platforms": ["hiringcafe", "greenhouse", "lever", "ashby", "efinancialcareers"],
  "postedWithin": "7 days",
  "maxJobs": 50
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

```json
{
  "title": "EMEA | Senior Data Business Analyst / Product Owner (Contractor)",
  "company": "Infinite Lambda",
  "location": "London",
  "otherLocations": ["Romania", "Sofia I Bulgaria", "Hungary", "Spain", "Slovakia", "Portugal"],
  "workType": "remote",
  "employmentType": "full-time",
  "department": "Customer Success",
  "team": "Customer Success",
  "salary": null,
  "postedAt": "2026-11-11T10:52:26.238+00:00",
  "jobUrl": "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Infinite%20Lambda/4bdf2b62-422f-4036-8645-cd1ffeef0a27",
  "applyUrl": "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Infinite%20Lambda/4bdf2b62-422f-4036-8645-cd1ffeef0a27/application",
  "status": "open",
  "platform": "ashby",
  "companySlug": "Infinite Lambda",
  "companyWebsite": "https://infinitelambda.com",
  "jobId": "4bdf2b62-422f-4036-8645-cd1ffeef0a27",
  "checkedAt": "2026-11-12T20:12:25+00:00"
}
```

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- Job boards and company career sites in one run, India's job boards included; the multi-board actors with 80+ users on 2026-11-13 read either applicant tracking systems or general job boards.
- Read live at run time, not from an index; each job once across boards; titles hold your words.
- Cheaper alternatives for narrower needs: bovi ($0.0015), yugenox ($0.002) and jtpalms ($0.003) for Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby only; most multi-board actors cost less than a search of all 18 boards here ($0.58 for 100 jobs).
